Returns FAQ

## How long does a customer have to return an item?

All items, including sale items, can be returned within 60 days of delivery. The 60 days start on the delivery date shown in the order history, not the order date.

Returns FAQ

## What condition does the item need to be in?

Items should be unused and in their original packaging where possible. Furniture that has been assembled can still be returned if it is undamaged, but the customer must disassemble it before collection.

Returns FAQ

## How does the customer start a return?

The customer starts the return from their order history on the Kestrel website. A prepaid return label is emailed to them. For large furniture, a collection is booked instead of a label.

Returns FAQ

## Who pays for return shipping?

Kestrel pays for return shipping on all returns within the return window.

#policy-updates: Sale item returns

**Posted by Finance Operations, Feb 2, 2026**

Policy change: sale item returns

Effective Tuesday, February 3, 2026, sale items can be returned within **30 days** of delivery. The previous window for sale items was 60 days.

Standard (full-price) items are unchanged and remain returnable within 60 days of delivery.

The window is based on the delivery date, not the order date. Orders delivered before February 3 keep the old 60-day window.

Please apply this from tomorrow's first shift. Questions to Finance Operations.

#policy-updates: Clearance items

**Posted by Finance Operations, Jun 10, 2026**

Policy change: Final Clearance items

Effective Tuesday, June 16, 2026, items tagged **"Final Clearance"** on the product page and receipt are **final sale**. They cannot be returned or refunded, except where they arrive damaged (follow the damaged item process).

All other sale items stay at the **30-day** return window from delivery. Standard items stay at 60 days.

Check the receipt for the "Final Clearance" tag before approving any sale item return.

Returns and Refunds Handbook

## Return windows

- Standard items: returnable within **60 days** of delivery.
- Sale items: returnable within **30 days** of delivery.

The window starts on the delivery date in the order history.

Returns and Refunds Handbook

## Refund timing

Refunds go back to the original payment method within **5 to 7 business days** after the returned item is received at the warehouse.

Returns and Refunds Handbook

## Agent refund authority

Agents can approve refunds up to **$150** per order without lead approval. Anything above $150 goes to a lead (see the Escalation Matrix).

Returns and Refunds Handbook

## Lead refund authority

Leads can approve refunds from **$150.01 to $1,000** per order. Refunds above $1,000 require approval from the Finance manager.

Leads can issue goodwill credit of up to **$50** per customer per order at their discretion. Log every goodwill credit in the order notes.

Refund Approval Guide

## Approval limits

- Leads approve refunds from **$150.01 to $1,000** per order.
- Refunds above **$1,000** need the Finance manager's approval. Send the order number and reason by email and wait for written approval before processing.

Refund Approval Guide

## Before approving

Check the account for a fraud flag before approving any refund. If the account is flagged, follow the Fraud and Serial-Returner Signals page.

Damaged Item Policy (Kestrel-sold items). This policy covers items sold and shipped by Kestrel. For items sold by marketplace sellers, use the Marketplace Seller Returns Policy.

## Reporting window

The customer must report damage within **14 days** of delivery and send at least one photo of the damage.

Damaged Item Policy (Kestrel-sold items). This policy covers items sold and shipped by Kestrel. For items sold by marketplace sellers, use the Marketplace Seller Returns Policy.

## Resolution

Kestrel refunds or replaces the item straight away, at the customer's choice. For items under **$75**, the customer does not need to return the damaged item.

Damaged items valued over $500 go to a lead before resolution (see the Escalation Matrix).

Marketplace Seller Returns Policy. This policy covers items sold by third-party marketplace sellers on the Kestrel website. The seller name appears on the product page and the receipt as "Sold by [seller]". For items sold by Kestrel, use the Damaged Item Policy.

## Damaged marketplace items

The customer must report damage within **7 days** of delivery and include photos.

The agent opens a claim with the seller through **Seller Hub**. The seller is responsible for the refund or replacement.

Marketplace Seller Returns Policy. This policy covers items sold by third-party marketplace sellers on the Kestrel website. The seller name appears on the product page and the receipt as "Sold by [seller]". For items sold by Kestrel, use the Damaged Item Policy.

## When Kestrel steps in

If the seller has not responded to the claim within **3 business days**, Kestrel refunds the customer and recovers the cost from the seller.

Fraud and Serial-Returner Signals

## Flagging criteria

Flag an account if any of the following apply:

- **4 or more returns in 90 days**
- Return value above **60% of total spend in the last 12 months**
- **2 or more "item not received" claims in 6 months**

Fraud and Serial-Returner Signals

## Handling flagged accounts

All refunds on a flagged account need lead approval, whatever the amount.

**Never tell the customer that the account is flagged** or describe these criteria to them. Explain any delay as a standard review.

Escalation Matrix

## When to escalate to a lead

| Situation | Escalate to |
|---|---|
| Refund above $150 | Lead |
| Account shows a fraud flag | Lead |
| Data deletion or privacy request | Lead, who forwards to Legal |
| Damaged item valued over $500 | Lead |
| Customer asks for a manager | Lead |

Escalation Matrix

## How to escalate

Assign the ticket to the "Leads" group in Zendesk with a one-line summary. On a live call, tell the customer a lead will follow up within one business day.

Identity Verification FAQ. Policy dated March 2024.

## How do I verify a caller?

Ask for the customer's full name and the order number. If both match the order, the caller is verified.

Identity Verification FAQ. Policy dated March 2024.

## What can I share once the caller is verified?

You can share the order status, tracking information and the delivery address on the order.

Customer Identity Verification

## Required checks

Before discussing any order, verify the caller with all of the following:

1. Full name
2. The email address on the account
3. One of: the last 4 digits of the payment card, or the billing postcode

An order number on its own is **never** enough to verify a caller.

Customer Identity Verification

## What you can share

Once verified, you can share order status and tracking. **Never read out the full delivery address.** You may confirm the city only.

Customer Identity Verification

## If verification fails

Do not share any order details. Offer to send the information to the email address on file.

Legal email: Identity verification requirements

**From:** Grace, Legal
**To:** Customer Support (all agents and leads)
**Date:** July 20, 2026
**Subject:** Identity verification requirements, effective July 21

Effective July 21, 2026, every caller must be verified with their full name, the email address on the account, and either the last 4 digits of the payment card or the billing postcode before any order is discussed. An order number alone does not verify a caller.

Do not read out a full delivery address under any circumstances. You may confirm the city.

If the caller cannot give the email address on the account, do not give tracking information by phone. Send the tracking link to the email address on the account instead.

These requirements replace all earlier guidance on caller verification.

Shipping and Delivery Handbook

## Delivery times

- Standard parcels: **3 to 5 business days**.
- Freight (large furniture): **7 to 14 business days**. The carrier calls the customer to book a delivery slot.

Shipping and Delivery Handbook

## Lost shipments

A shipment is considered lost after **10 business days** with no movement on the carrier's tracking scans.

Once a shipment is lost, offer the customer a reship or a full refund.

Carrier Escalation Guide

## Opening a carrier trace

If tracking shows no movement for **5 business days**, open a trace with the carrier from the carrier portal. Tell the customer the trace is open and that you will update them within 2 business days.

Carrier Escalation Guide

## Early reship authority

Leads may authorize a reship before the shipment is confirmed lost, for orders under **$300**, when a trace is open and the customer needs the item urgently. Note the reason in the order.

#policy-updates: Freight delays

**Posted by Operations, Sep 29, 2026**

Temporary change: freight delays

Our freight carrier is short on capacity. From **October 1 to November 15, 2026**, freight shipments (large furniture) are considered lost after **15 business days** with no tracking movement, instead of 10.

Standard parcels are not affected and stay at 10 business days.

We will post again when this ends.

Warranty Claims FAQ

## Warranty periods

- Furniture: **2 years** on structural defects (frames, joints, mechanisms).
- Appliances: **1 year**.

Warranty Claims FAQ

## Making a claim

The customer needs proof of purchase. Claims are submitted through the warranty form on the website. Normal wear and tear is not covered.

Appliance Warranty Notes

Appliances sold by Kestrel carry a **2-year** warranty. Proof of purchase is required for any claim.

Payment Dispute Playbook

## Duplicate charges

This includes duplicate charges through Klarna. The lead confirms the duplicate in the payment dashboard and refunds it within **24 hours**.

Payment Dispute Playbook

## Chargebacks

Respond to every chargeback notice within **7 days**. Attach the order record and delivery proof.

**Never admit liability in writing** in a chargeback response or in any message to the customer about a dispute.
